map.光圈、快门、ISO三者平衡，根据拍摄需求取舍: Balance aperture, shutter speed and ISO according to the shot.
map.尽量使用相机原生ISO（通常100/200/400/800等），扩展ISO画质下: Prefer the camera's native ISO (usually 100/200/400/800 etc.); extended ISO degrades quality.

map.彩色杂色，通常比亮度噪点更明显，也更容易被消除: Coloured artefacts, usually more visible than luminance noise and easier to remove.
map.长曝光或高温下产生的固定噪点，通常是红/绿/蓝的亮点: Fixed noise from long exposures or high temperatures, usually red/green/blue bright dots.

map.在安全快门范围内，用更慢的快门换取更低的ISO: Within the safe shutter range, use a slower shutter to allow a lower ISO.
map.可以用很低的快门速度，保持低ISO拍摄: Lets you shoot at very slow shutter speeds while keeping ISO low.
map.使用闪光灯或持续光源补充光线，从根本上减少噪点: Use a flash or continuous light to add light and reduce noise at the source.
map.RAW文件保留更多信息，后期降噪空间更大: RAW files retain more information, leaving more room for noise reduction later.
map.细节面板中的明亮度降噪和颜色降噪，效果优秀: Luminance and colour noise reduction in the detail panel work excellently.
map.AI降噪软件，效果出色，适合大幅打印: AI noise-reduction software, excellent results, suited to large prints.
map.RAW级别的AI降噪，处理后再进LR: RAW-level AI noise reduction, then back into Lightroom.
map.Camera Raw滤镜或降噪插件: Camera Raw filter or noise-reduction plugin
map.了解自己相机的可用ISO上限，不轻易超过: Know your camera's usable ISO ceiling and don't exceed it lightly.
map.重要场景建议RAW+JPG双格式，保留后期空间: For important shots, shoot RAW+JPG to keep post-processing options open.
map.拍到比拍好重要，现代相机高感已经很优秀: Getting the shot matters more than a perfect shot; modern cameras handle high ISO very well.
map.过度降噪会损失细节，找到噪点和细节的平衡点: Over-reduction loses detail; find the balance between noise and detail.
map.如果只是网络分享，缩图后噪点会明显减少: If sharing online only, downscaled images show noticeably less noise.
